style: gentle educational storybook meal scenes for young Chinese learners

items.label: Eat school lunch
items.sentenceHanzi: 安安在学校食堂吃午饭。
items.sentencePinyin: An an zai xue xiao shi tang chi wu fan.
items.sentenceEnglish: Anan is eating lunch in the school cafeteria.
items.theme: Anan has pizza and sips milk at a straight cafeteria table

items.label: No Coke
items.hanzi: 我要喝可乐。没有可乐，你可以喝水。
items.pinyin: Wǒ yào hē kě lè. Méi yǒu kě lè, nǐ kě yǐ hē shuǐ.
items.sentenceEnglish: Anan wants Coke; Mom offers water instead.
items.theme: Anan looks for Coke in the open refrigerator while Mom offers water
